verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms help.puzzle.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content (an agent-oriented docs index), and Puzzle's own docs also describe an MCP server for connecting agents like Claude to its data, corroborating agent-first documentation access. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of an agent successfully using llms.txt in practice, and a fuller llms.txt content sample beyond the truncated snippet.
